'''Alethios''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] stationed at [[Wardpost Landa]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
